title: anthemis kuzmanovii
intro: Anthemis kuzmanovii, commonly known as a flowering plant in the daisy family, is a species of Anthemis, a genus of flowering plants. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis kuzmanovii include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and act as a mild sedative. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
